method: Nearest-rank quantiles. Twelve held-stroke first-visible samples per display/detail/profile/scenario (four brushes x three repetitions), excluding explicitly unobserved pixel changes. Per-brush distributions have only three samples. Capture and tracing overhead included; frame swaps, not photons. Main tasks are all extracted RunTask durations during each monitored gesture. Main-stage and worker-stage samples are last-512 windows; count/total/max cover the full task. Native coordinates and exact post-stroke words are compared across before/after runs.
